article.title: BMW X3 M40i Cooling System Guide
article.summary: Pillar guide covering the BMW X3 G01 M40i B58 cooling system architecture, maintenance priorities, and common failure areas.
article.excerpt: Understand the X3 M40i cooling system from water pump to expansion tank, and how to maintain reliable B58 engine temperatures.

seo.seo_title: BMW X3 M40i Cooling System Guide
seo.meta_description: Complete BMW X3 M40i cooling system guide for the B58 engine including components, maintenance, and common problems.

content.intro: The BMW X3 G01 M40i uses a complex cooling circuit designed for the B58 turbocharged engine. This pillar guide explains the major components and how supporting problem articles fit together.

blocks.text: The B58 cooling system includes an electric water pump, thermostat housing, radiator, and expansion tank. Supporting articles cover coolant loss and water pump failure in detail.
